items.text:
Judge allows NAACP lawsuit against xAI over unpermitted data-center turbines to proceed

• A federal judge denied xAI's motion to dismiss a lawsuit filed by the NAACP that alleges the company operated at least 35 combustion turbines at its Colossus data centre in Memphis without required permits.
• AI has delivered zero financial payoff to non-tech firms in the S&P 493, according to Apollo economist Torsten Slok.
• Early adopters reported that the device could display avatars and connect to the Muse cloud but struggled with voice output and smart-home discovery.
